cards.question:
Swap two elements

Exchange `arr[i]` and `arr[j]` in-place.

Insert an element by shifting right

Insert `value` into array `arr` at index `pos`, shifting elements `[pos, n)` one position right.

Remove an element by shifting left

Remove `arr[pos]` from an array of logical length `n`.

Reverse array in-place

Reverse an array without allocating another array.

Rotate array left by one position

Transform `[a b c d e] -> [b c d e a]`

Rotate array right by one position

Transform: `[a b c d e] → [e a b c d]`

Rotate array left using three reversals

Rotate an array left by `k` positions in-place.

E.g. for `[a b c d e f g]` and `k = 3` produce `[d e f g a b c]`

Rotate array right using three reversals

Rotate an array right by `k` positions in-place.

E.g. for `[a b c d e f g]` and `k = 3` produce `[e f g a b c d]`
